name: Ruby on Rails
server: Puma 8.1 behind Thruster 0.1, as in the Dockerfile rails new generates
workers: Puma cluster mode: WEB_CONCURRENCY = BENCH_WORKERS (2) workers x 3 threads (the generated RAILS_MAX_THREADS default)
database_layer: Active Record (pg 1.7), up to 8 connections per worker (16 in total)
logging: Rails at warn (no request lines); Thruster's request log off
notes: The rails new production setup; force_ssl stays commented out (no TLS) and db:prepare does not run at start-up.
